name: King Slide Works Co., Ltd.
summary: King Slide Works Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, designs, manufactures, distributes, and sells rail kits for cloud servers, network communications, kitchen ware, and consumer electronics in Taiwan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company offers ultra-thin server slide rail kits, electronic device rail kits, and cable management arm for cloud computing data centers, as well as engages in international investment activities.
